g.text: Chitrax is an ultra-fast, privacy-first web workspace for creative image manipulation and multi-page PDF processing.
Engineered with Astro 7, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, and Rust WebAssembly, Chitrax runs all computation 100% client-side
inside the user's browser via multi-threaded Web Workers and local ONNX AI models.
Zero file uploads. Zero server logs. Zero cloud storage.
Your sensitive images and documents never leave your computer.
AI Background removal with a custom
Rust WASM guided filter for precise
